subject: Re: RE: FW: VIENNA AIRPORT - MEX / 208 PLT 494 KGS
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

My buyer has withdrawn the order, so I need to cancel the shipment. Please do not book it. If you have already booked it, please cancel the booking.

I apologise for the inconvenience.

Mit freundlichen Gruessen / Kind regards
Jonas Kessler
Logistics Coordinator
Kessler Feinmechanik GmbH, Ulm

classification.reasoning: The customer says the order was withdrawn and asks us not to book, or to cancel any existing booking.
